label: (6,6) CNT membrane, pure SPC/E water, 300 K: pore-flow calibration

source.releaseBasis: to be stated before use (for example CC BY 4.0 for the crossing data)
source.engine: LAMMPS stable 22 Jul 2025 (update 4) with MOLECULE, KSPACE, RIGID

model.water: rigid SPC/E (q_O = -0.8476 e, eps_OO = 0.15535 kcal/mol, sigma_OO = 3.166 A, O-H 1.0 A, H-O-H 109.47 deg, SHAKE 1e-5)
model.carbon: fixed positions, carbon-carbon pairs excluded, uncharged
model.waterCarbon: Lennard-Jones on oxygen only, eps_CO = 0.09352 kcal/mol, sigma_CO = 3.190 A (Werder et al. 2003)
model.cutoffs: 10 A real space, analytic tails off, PPPM 1e-5

geometry.membrane: two graphene sheets sealing the tube ends; hole radius R + 1.4 A
geometry.note: the lab's domain pitch is 10 nm; access resistance of a sub-nanometre pore is expected to be small at both pitches, but the pitch dependence is unverified and must be stated or tested (one run at a larger lateral cell)

drive.method: force slab: fz on every water oxygen inside a 10 A slab in the reservoir middle
drive.mapping: dP = <N_slab> fz / (Lx Ly), 1 kcal mol^-1 A^-1 = 6.9477e-11 N
drive.thermostat: Nose-Hoover on x and y velocity components only (temp/partial 1 1 0), 100 fs

referencePlanes: the two membrane faces (graphene sheet planes); the slab is far from both, so dP is the reservoir-to-reservoir pressure difference across the membrane
includedResistance: entrance + interior + exit of one pore, and the access region within the MD cell; the chamber flow is resolved by the continuum solver and must not be added again

protocol.equilibration: 2 ps limited NVE, then NVT 300 K until the number of molecules in the tube has a stable plateau (at least 200 ps); restart file written
protocol.production: 20 ns per replica after 100 ps of drive switch-on (discarded)
protocol.replicas: at least 4 per driven condition and 8 at zero drive (equilibrium gate: G_eq to 10 %), independent velocities (seeds) from the equilibrated restart, or independent equilibrations

interpolationPolicy: linear law accepted only inside the tested drive interval; the 0-10 MPa operating range of the lab is covered only if the zero-drive equilibrium estimate agrees with the driven slope and the linearity test passes
unsupported: other chiralities, lengths, temperatures or salt
pitches other than the stated one without a pitch test
